text:
rebecca.k: hi all, first-day question — got a MacBook Air (M2, serial MA2026REBECCA). Company Setup shows "Management Pending" and disk utility shows encryption off. trying to install homebrew but it prompts for admin. also Docker fails with "bad CPU type in executable". any quick path to finish onboarding remotely?

mdm-bot: new device detected serial=MA2026REBECCA enrollment_state=pending. Suggested flow: connect to corp-vpn or corp-secure SSID and retry Company Setup -> Re-enroll. Self-service: https://idp.redwood.example.com/self-enroll

rebecca.k: i'm remote and on home ISP — will try corp-vpn now. quick Q: if FileVault is Off, will re-enroll push it automatically or will I be prompted?

ezra.it: welcome! MDM usually pushes a FileVault profile post-enrollment which prompts you to enable encryption under your corp account. if the DEP token is stale it may require manual push from IT. please run and paste the short outputs of these two commands so we can triage:

```
/usr/bin/fdesetup status
profiles show --type enrollment
```

rebecca.k: pasted:
```
FileVault is Off
Enrollment status: Pending
MDM Server: jamf.redwood.local
```

pat.sre: Docker error is due to missing Rosetta. Once you have admin you can run:
```
softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license
```
then install Docker Desktop for Apple Silicon. we avoid giving permanent admin; IT can grant a time-limited sudo for installs.

ezra.it: opening ticket IT-4932 with serial and screenshot. i'll attempt a remote re-enroll push; if that doesn't finish in 10 minutes we'll grant temporary admin for 8-24h depending on need.

ops-bot: re-enroll job queued for MA2026REBECCA (job=2026-03-11-21). status: queued -> running.

rebecca.k: thanks. while we wait, what about dev certs? I need to run `spctl --master-disable` to load a local dev cert for our stack. is that allowed with temp admin?

ezra.it: yes, document the reason in IT ticket and we'll include it in the scope. temporary admin will allow `sudo` for these commands; we'll log actions and revoke automatically.

ops-bot: re-enroll job completed: device enrolled and managed.

ezra.it: pushing FileVault profile now and rotating bootstrap token to ensure MDM can enable without losing escrow. you should get an OS dialog to enable FileVault. proceed and use your corp account (rebecca.k@redwood.com) when prompted.

rebecca.k: dialog popped up, enabled FileVault and got recovery location confirmation. running `fdesetup status` now returns `FileVault is On.` :tada:

pat.sre: great — temporary sudo granted (expires in 18h) per IT-4932. run the rosetta installer then reinstall Docker for Apple Silicon from the official site. after you're done, paste Docker version and any errors into the ticket.

rebecca.k: installed rosetta and Docker, confirmed containers start. Homebrew works now. thanks for the fast help!

ezra.it: ticket IT-4932 updated with actions and expiry. please add the exact commands you ran so we can add it to the new-hires runbook.

pat.sre: small checklist for future new-hires: 1) ensure corp-vpn or corp-secure during enrollment, 2) check `profiles show` for enrollment state, 3) expect FileVault prompt post-enroll, 4) request time-limited sudo for Rosetta/Docker if remote.

rebecca.k: will add steps to the ticket. thanks everyone and excited to be here!
